newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle market slow at $66-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle market slow at $66-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets on the first traded day of the New Year were slow, with light sales at $66.00 per cwt, down $1.00 from Tuesday's top price achieved in thin volume, feedlot sources said.
Most of the trade was in Kansas, with 5,300 head sold, bringing the holiday week to date to 27,500 confirmed, including 19,800 head previously contracted or formulated cattle, USDA said.
About 200 head sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area, which brought the weekly figure to 19,100, including 16,700 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
